bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
source=9655437b10ecb9063ee596d3901fdb1e8244136e
ci_profile=44977636085
ci_package=44977636086
current_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-batch-db17
new_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-help-9655437
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-help-20261122
local_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
test "$(gh run view "$ci_profile" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$source success" || exit 60
test "$(gh run view "$ci_package" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$source success" || exit 61
oldid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$current_tag")" || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 63
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$oldid" || exit 64
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$local_tag")" = "$oldid" || exit 65
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 66
test -z "$(docker images -q "$new_tag")" || exit 67
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM profile_keyboard_backfill WHERE state='applied';")" = 7 || exit 68
before="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||thread_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id||':'||synced_revision FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,thread_id,message_id;")" || exit 69
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$before" | wc -l)" -eq 7 || exit 70
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-startless-help-build.XXXXXXXX)"
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback" "$local_tag" || true
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
gh run download "$ci_package" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
test -s "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" && test -s "$tmp/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs" && test -s "$tmp/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs" || exit 72
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node "$current_tag" --check /bundle/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 73
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node "$current_tag" --check /bundle/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs >/dev/null || exit 74
cat >"$tmp/Dockerfile" <<'DOCKER'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-batch-db17
COPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
COPY --chown=1000:1000 backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs /app/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs
COPY --chown=1000:1000 refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs /app/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs
DOCKER
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$new_tag" -f "$tmp/Dockerfile" "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 75
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$new_tag")"
test "$newid" != "$oldid" || exit 76
if docker image inspect "$rollback" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback")" = "$oldid" || exit 77
else
 docker tag "$oldid" "$rollback"
fi
docker tag "$new_tag" "$local_tag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || exit 78
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 79
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || exit 80
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 18);do
 if docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq GAYBBS_BOT_READY;then ready=1;break;fi
 sleep 5
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 82
after="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||thread_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id||':'||synced_revision FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,thread_id,message_id;")" || exit 83
test "$before" = "$after" || exit 84
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM profile_keyboard_backfill WHERE state='applied';")" = 7 || exit 85
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(sha256sum "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" || exit 86
ok=1
echo STARTLESS_HELP_BOT_IMAGE=APPLIED
echo EXISTING_PROFILE_SEVEN=UNCHANGED
echo USERBOT_SESSION=ACTIVE
echo ROLLBACK_IMAGE=RETAINED
echo STARTLESS_EXISTING_POST_REPAIR=SEPARATE
